baseline_prompt_en: Create a full-length photorealistic editorial conservation photograph of one unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties or older inside a shallowly flooded art-deco underground transit concourse. She is fully clothed in a fitted charcoal waterproof conservation coverall, sealed work boots, nitrile gloves, and a narrow utility belt. Her upper torso and shoulders are visibly narrower than her lower body; a sharply defined waist flows into a pronounced high-hip shelf, broad rounded hips, and visibly fuller upper thighs, with the widest contour concentrated below the waist. Her body proportions are newly authored from this written geometry. Her facial appearance—face shape, features, complexion, hairline, and hairstyle—takes its cue only from the attached image. In a clear three-quarter full-body view, the conservator draws a low-pressure suction wand along one loosened tessera seam to remove flood silt. An illuminated geometric mosaic, brass transit trim, numbered condition tags, rippling reflections, and exposed colored tesserae establish the emergency conservation site. Cool work lights rake across wet tile while warm restored fixtures glow beyond, keeping her waist-to-hip silhouette and precise professional action immediately readable.
